# TestaScreen

> TestaScreen is a free set of browser-based hardware tests - dead pixels, backlight bleed, response time/ghosting, brightness, contrast and full-screen color panels, plus microphone, webcam, keyboard and click speed tests - with guides on how to read the results and what to do about defects.

All tools run entirely in the browser (no install, no account). The site is in English.

## Tests

- [Dead Pixel Test](https://testascreen.com/dead-pixel-test): Cycle full-screen colors to spot dead, stuck or hot pixels.
- [Dead Pixel Fixer](https://testascreen.com/dead-pixel-fixer): Flash rapidly changing colors to try to unstick a stuck pixel (not guaranteed; dead pixels can't be fixed by software).
- [Backlight Bleed Test](https://testascreen.com/backlight-bleed-test): Near-black screen to check for backlight bleed and IPS glow.
- [Response Time & Ghosting Test](https://testascreen.com/monitor-response-time-test): Moving pattern to check ghosting, overshoot and overdrive settings.
- [Brightness Test](https://testascreen.com/brightness-test): Gray ladder and gradients for brightness and uniformity.
- [Contrast Test](https://testascreen.com/contrast-test): Near-black and near-white detail checks.
- [Color Screens](https://testascreen.com/tools): White, black, red, green, blue, pink, purple, orange and yellow full-screen panels.
- [Zoom Lighting](https://testascreen.com/zoom-lighting): Use the screen as a soft fill light for video calls.

## Hardware tests

- [Mic Test](https://testascreen.com/mic-test): Live input level, waveform and a 5-second recording played back locally. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Keyboard Test](https://testascreen.com/keyboard-test): Press every key on an ANSI or ISO layout to find dead keys, chattering and ghosting.
- [Webcam Test](https://testascreen.com/webcam-test): Live preview with the resolution and frame rate the camera really delivers.
- [Click Speed Test](https://testascreen.com/click-speed-test): Clicks per second over 1, 5, 10 or 30 seconds; also shows a mouse that double clicks.
